fieldValues.title: Inspector
fieldValues.summary: The selected block's other fields (settings, keys and, with Show briefs on, its brief), its alternatives, and Move to drafts or Move to bin.
fieldValues.explanation: Fields the site does not draw are edited here: a block's key, its settings, and its brief (the editor-only intent, shown with View > Show briefs). Alternatives are drafts derived from the block; Swap in puts one in its place.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Point the writer at the brief before they write: it says who a block is for and what it must do.
